scope: critical-only learnability test for message-conditioned receiver actions
principles: train on two independent handoff pairs whose left and right worlds passed the receiver screen and whose receivers use different policy slots
include both latent worlds of both pairs in every update so pair identity and private observation cannot identify the active target
train only the receiver's first ACT span with eight common-random replicas per group
use a compact receiver view containing the inbox, legal actions, and only action-relevant private state
derive every advantage from replay-verified terminal team return; add no action, capture, target, or communication reward
reserve matched decoys for checkpoint evaluation rather than spending half the optimizer batch on an easier generic capture pattern
retain two remaining turns for the previously measured terminal-return contrast

stages.name: compact_pairs_7_9_two_worlds
stages.purpose: make message-conditioned target switching the only repeated cross-world rule

primary_success_measure: critical generated-minus-dropped receiver target-action and terminal-return lift on held-out development pairs
specificity_measure: critical-minus-matched-decoy intervention lift, evaluated but never optimized
checkpoint_selection: development-only after update 40; intermediate pulses are diagnostic
frozen_policy: the existing RL-v4 frozen OOD evaluation remains byte-identical and unopened until development selection
limitation: success establishes message-conditioned learnability across two training pairs, not broad swarm intelligence
